data = [280, 240, 211, 157, 139, 110, 95, 88]

# Calculate smoothed values for each period

    s = alpha * data[i-1] + (1 - alpha) * smoothed[i-1]
    smoothed.append(s)

print("Single Exponential Smoothing (alpha=0.4)")

for i, (year, val) in enumerate(zip(range(1960, 1968), data)):
    print(f"FY {year}: Actual = {val}, Smoothed = {smoothed[i]:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"FY 1968 Forecast: {forecast:.2f} million dollars")
EOF
